def transform(grid):
    # Rotate the source 180 degrees, then reflect it across both axes.
    base = [list(reversed(row)) for row in reversed(grid)]
    wide = [row + list(reversed(row)) for row in base]
    return wide + list(reversed(wide)) + wide
